text: MYQUANT  |  Oxford Quant-First portfolio

• Equipment portfolio spans patterning, transistor and interconnect fabrication, process control and advanced packaging.
• AI-related demand can raise the importance of leading-edge logic, high-bandwidth memory and packaging; it does not remove cyclicality.
• Applied Global Services adds spares, services and factory-automation software linked to the installed base.
• The investment question is not ‘AI is growing’; it is whether incremental process intensity, service attach and mix are above what the market already prices.

Disconfirming risks
The thesis should fail clearly if the evidence turns
textPreview: The thesis should fail clearly if the evidence turns

text: MYQUANT  |  Oxford Quant-First portfolio

• Foundry or memory capex cuts and weaker returns on recently built capacity.
• Trade and export restrictions, including greater difficulty serving some customers or regions.
• Customer concentration: the FY2025 10-K reports two customers contributing approximately 19% and 15% of net revenue.
• Technological substitution, share loss, execution delays or lower-than-expected services resilience.
• A valuation that already assumes a sustained step-up in growth or margins.
